fragments.text: Good morning, and welcome to Oniton Hall, one of the
in the area.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 早上好，欢迎来到奥尼顿庄园，这是本地区最大的庄园之一。

fragments.text: My name's Nick, and I'm one of the

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我叫尼克，是这里的导游之一。

fragments.text: I'll give you a
to the estate while you're sitting down, and then we'll walk round.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 你们先坐着，我先简单介绍一下庄园，然后我们再四处走走。

fragments.text: The estate consists of the house, gardens, parkland and farm, and it dates back to the

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 庄园包括住宅、花园、公园绿地和农场，其历史可以追溯到14世纪。

fragments.text: The original house was replaced in the late seventeenth century, and of course it has had a large number of owners.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 原来的房子在17世纪末被替换了，当然，它有过很多主人。

fragments.text: Almost all of them have left their mark, generally by
, like the
and
, or by
others.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 几乎每个人都在这里留下了印记，通常是通过增建房间，比如舞厅和温室，或者拆掉其他部分。

fragments.text: The farm looks much as it's always done, although the
owner has done a great deal of work to the flower beds.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 农场景观和过去差不多，尽管现任主人花了很多精力修整花坛。

fragments.text: In the seventeenth century, the estate was owned by a very
called Sir Edward Downes.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 17世纪，庄园的主人是一个非常富有的男人，叫爱德华·唐斯爵士。

fragments.text: His intention was to
the world of politics, after years as an
, and to build a new house worthy of his big collection of books, paintings and sculptures.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 他打算逃离政界，此前多年他是一名活跃的政治家，并建造一栋配得上他大量藏书、画作和雕塑收藏的新房子。

fragments.text: He broke off contact with his former
and hosted meetings of creative and literary people, like painters and poets.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 他断绝了与前政治盟友的联系，并主持了创意和文学人士的聚会，如画家和诗人。

fragments.text: Unusually for his time, he didn't care whether his
were rich or poor, as long as they had talent.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 在他那个时代不寻常的是，他不在乎客人是富是穷，只要他们有才华。

fragments.text: Big houses like Oniton had dozens of servants until the
and we've tried to show what their working lives were like.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 像奥尼顿这样的大房子直到20世纪20或30年代还有几十个仆人，我们尽量展示他们的工作生活。

fragments.text: of course don't give much of an idea, so instead, as you go round the house, you'll see volunteers
as nineteenth-century
going about their work.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 照片当然不能提供太多信息，所以，当你参观房子时，会看到志愿者打扮成19世纪的仆人，从事他们的工作。

fragments.text: They'll explain what they're doing, and tell you their
or what tools they're using.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 他们会解释自己在做什么，并告诉你他们的食谱或使用的工具。

fragments.text: We've just introduced this
to
the audio guide we used to have available.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我们刚刚引入了这个特色来取代我们以前使用的语音导览。

fragments.text: I see there are a number of children here with you today.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我看到今天有很多孩子和你们一起来。

fragments.text: Well, we have several activities specially for children, like
in the sorts of clothes that children wore in the past, and as it's a fine day, some of you will probably want to play in the

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 嗯，我们有几项专门为儿童准备的活动，比如试穿过去儿童穿的衣服，而且今天天气很好，有些人可能想去冒险乐园玩。

fragments.text: Our latest addition is that you can
around the grounds.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我们最新推出的是可以开着儿童大小的拖拉机在园地里转悠。

fragments.text: We'll also be going into the farm that's part of the estate, where there's plenty to do.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 我们还会去到作为庄园一部分的农场，那里有很多事情可做。

fragments.text: Most of the buildings date from the eighteenth century, so you can really step back into an

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 大多数建筑都建于18世纪，所以你真的可以回到农业时代的过去。

fragments.text: Until recently, the dairy was where milk from the
was turned into

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 直到最近，奶牛场还是把牛奶变成奶酪的地方。

fragments.text: It's now the place to go for lunch, or
or just a cup of coffee and a slice of homemade cake.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 它现在是吃午饭、喝下午茶或只喝杯咖啡吃块自制蛋糕的地方。

fragments.text: The big stone building that
the farm is the large barn, and in here is our collection of agricultural tools.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 在农场中占主导地位的大石头建筑是大谷仓，里面是我们的农具藏品。

fragments.text: These were used in the past to plough the earth, sow seeds, make gates, and much more.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 这些在过去被用来犁地、播种、做大门等等。

fragments.text: There's a small barn, also made of stone, where you can groom the donkeys and horses, to keep their coats clean. They really seem to enjoy having it done, and children love grooming them.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 还有一个小谷仓，也是石头建的，你可以在那里给驴和马梳毛，保持它们的皮毛清洁。它们似乎真的很享受这样，孩子们也喜欢给它们梳毛。

fragments.text: The horses no longer live in the
which instead is the place to go to
books, our own
and clothes and blankets made of wool from our sheep.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 马不再住在马厩里了，取而代之的是，马厩成了购买礼品、我们的果酱和泡菜以及由我们自己的羊毛制成的衣服和毯子的地方。

fragments.text: Outside the shed, which is the only brick building, you can
a horse-drawn
for a lovely, relaxing tour of the park and farm.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 在棚子外面——这是唯一的砖砌建筑——你可以爬上一辆马车，进行一趟愉快轻松的公园和农场之旅。

fragments.text: The carriages are well over a hundred years old.

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 这些马车已经有一百多年的历史了。

fragments.text: And finally, the parkland, which was laid out in the eighteenth century, with a lake and trees that are

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 最后，公园绿地，建于18世纪，有湖泊和现在已经长势良好的树木。

fragments.text: You'll see types of cattle and sheep that are hardly ever found on farms these days. We're helping to preserve them, to stop their

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 你会看到如今农场里几乎找不到的牛羊。我们正在帮助保护它们，以阻止它们的数量进一步下降。

fragments.text: OK, well if you'd like to come with me ...

sentences.speaker: Guide
sentences.translation: 好的，如果你想跟我来的话……

title: 奥尼顿庄园介绍 (Oniton Hall estate tour)
